meta.name: hugging-science
meta.description: Use when the user is doing AI/ML work in a scientific domain such as biology, chemistry, physics, astronomy, climate, genomics, materials, medicine, ecology, energy, engineering, math, drug discovery, protein design, weather modeling, theorem proving, single-cell, or PDE solving. Hugging Science is a curated catalog of scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive Spaces. This skill helps discover and use resources via `datasets`, `transformers`, the HF Inference API, `gradio_client`, and methodology citations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并使用科学领域的AI模型与数据集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做生物、化学、物理等科学领域的AI/ML工作
copy.tagline_en: Discover and use AI models and datasets for scientific domains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing AI/ML work in biology, chemistry, physics, or other scientific fields

howto.what: 当用户询问科学领域的AI/ML问题时，Claude会从Hugging Science的精选目录中查找科学数据集、模型、博客和交互式演示，并推荐合适的资源。
howto.when: 当用户提到生物学、化学、物理学等科学领域，或询问科学数据集/模型，或需要微调科学数据、复现科学ML论文时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个蛋白质语言模型，比如ESM2。
say.note: Claude会从目录中查找并推荐相关模型。

say.text: 有没有用于药物发现的公开数据集？
say.note: Claude会搜索化学和生物学相关的数据集。

say.text: 我想用BoltzGen设计一个蛋白质结合剂。

howto.what_en: When the user asks AI/ML questions in scientific domains, Claude searches the Hugging Science curated catalog for scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive demos, then recommends suitable resources.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions scientific domains like biology, chemistry, physics, or asks for scientific datasets/models, or wants to fine-tune on scientific data or reproduce a scientific ML paper.

say_en.text: Find me a protein language model like ESM2.
say_en.note: Claude will search the catalog and recommend relevant models.

say_en.text: Are there public datasets for drug discovery?
say_en.note: Claude will search for datasets related to chemistry and biology.

say_en.text: I want to design a protein binder using BoltzGen.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to use the interactive demo on Hugging Face Spaces.
